note: Owner-level fixes rather than another override. overflow-wrap:anywhere was applied to every paragraph, heading, list item, link and span in design-refinements.css — it does not only break long words, it lets a heading collapse to one letter per line in a narrow column; narrowed to break-word, with anywhere kept for URLs and identifiers.
